rule.tier_a: quote present AND quote-relation aligned AND confidence >= 0.8
rule.tier_b: retrieval-only; includes aligned quotes with confidence < 0.8
rule.tier_c: not retrieval-safe because relation support, direction, or endpoint alignment fails

interpretation: The implementation now enforces the requested threshold. The frozen pilot's eight already-exposed paths all happened to have hop confidence >=0.8, so this re-gating did not change final path coverage.
